Abstract.AbstractText: The application of proteomics in the research of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) is very extensive, and there have been many successful cases. In this paper, the previous studies on the complex system of TCM by using proteomics technology were reviewed, and the authors proposed to set up a special subject on proteomics in TCM, which is called TCM proteomics. In this paper, the research strategies and the future research directions of TCM proteomics were reviewed and discussed, which may provide some ideas for the researchers of TCM proteomics.
